paragraphs: Rav Naḥman son of Rav Ḥisda—see his brothers there—in Rav Ḥisda's name, Shabbat 147a; in R. Tavla's name. He sent to Rav Naḥman bar Yaakov, 'Let our teacher instruct us,' Sanhedrin 24b; Ketubbot 104b; Bava Batra 46b, where Rav Yosef sat before him. Sanhedrin 8a: Rav Naḥman bar Yaakov told him his grandfather had said in Rav's name. He imposed a tax on rabbis; Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak said he transgressed Torah, Prophets and Writings, Bava Batra 8a. R. Naḥman bar Yitzḥak called him a maneh son of a maneh (see his entry). He expounded: R. Simai testified in Ḥaggai, Zekharyah and Malakhi's name, etc. Rava called it nonsense; Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak said, 'I stated it,' Ḥullin 88b. Shevuot 12b: 'I stated it in Rav Shimi of Nehardea's name.'
